purpose: Compare executable actions rather than treating correlated playbook evidence for one frozen plan as competing trades.

action_identity.price_rounding: prices must already be tick aligned; no tolerance-based outcome-dependent merging

equivalent_action_rule.definition: All action-identity fields are equal after fixed tick/minute normalization.
equivalent_action_rule.evidence_aggregation: Retain every contributing hypothesis key and use the maximum constituent utility as the conservative action utility; do not sum or independence-combine correlated probabilities.
equivalent_action_rule.margin_comparison: The minimum-advantage gate compares the best unique action against the next different unique action, including abstain.
equivalent_action_rule.belief_authority: Contributing playbook probabilities remain thesis-strength evidence and never become managed-return labels.

competing_plan_rules.same_entry_target_deadline_different_inv: different structural stop plan; keep separate
competing_plan_rules.stop_arbitration: No automatic tighter/looser-stop preference. Each frozen structural stop must pass risk independently; close utilities remain genuine plan uncertainty.

leave_one_playbook_out.comparison_unit: unique action identity at the same causal decision clock
leave_one_playbook_out.retirement_rule: Merge or retire only in a new major playbook registry when a removed playbook has no stable incremental action coverage or time-out-of-sample managed-net-value contribution.

forbidden: Treating equivalent playbook evidence as the second-best competing action
Adding correlated playbook probabilities as if independent
Choosing equivalence tolerances from June-July PnL
Selecting a stop after observing its realized path
Changing any playbook sequence, invalidation, target, or deadline rule
